set.notes: UPDATED 2026-11-18 (research batch 7): RESOLVED. The proposal, in the corrected transcript of 22 May 2026, from Unions NSW's research and policy officer (by role): 'Our recommendation is to require local content no less than that set by the Renewable Energy Sector Board, both for data centres and the associated renewable energy', and, of a market-based renewable funding model, 'a risk ... of it being opaque' so local content could not be tracked. Assessed against what was adopted: the NSW Data Centre Guidelines (August 2026), performance measure 16, say only that data centres 'are encouraged to prioritise use of local content where possible'; apprenticeship targets appear as things developers 'could' adopt with unions. None of the 20 archived consent instruments mentions local content. So the proposal was not adopted as a requirement, in the guidelines or in any consent read. Whether a market mechanism would be opaque is a prediction the record cannot test.

add_sources.quote: Our recommendation is to require local content no less than that set by the Renewable Energy Sector Board, both for data centres and the associated renewable energy. | I think there's a risk if there's a market mechanism of it being opaque a nd us not being able to really track the localcontent that then goes into that renewable energy.
Data centres are encouraged to prioritise use of local content where possible and engage with NSW Government on opportunities to support local supply chains.
